answer.why: Both Century Communities and KB Home are US national homebuilders that design, build and sell new residential homes (single-family, townhomes, condos) directly to individual homebuyers, supported by affiliated mortgage and title services. They operate in overlapping states (TX, FL, CO, AZ, WA among others) and target the same buyer segments (first-time, move-up buyers). Product and customer overlap is essentially complete.

C:P1.1.text: New Home Builders In Your Area - KB Home

C:P1.2.text: KB Home builds homes for the way you live. Find new homes for sale with open floor plans, energy-efficient features and personalize to fit your style.

C:P1.3.text: We build homes for all of life’s small but epic moments. That’s why we put our experience in the service of your dreams and partner with you to design a new home that reflects your style and budget. We devote our attention to you. We listen to you. And we do all of that before we even break ground. Because we see you.

C:P1.10.text: We offer lots of great ways to make daily life easier, thanks to smart home devices and appliances, like thermostats, wall switches, and garage door openers.

C:P1.11.text: Greater comfort, well-being and savings come standard.

C:P1.12.text: Home should be the best place of all, so ours are built to boost energy and water efficiency, lower utility costs and conserve natural resources. We also include quality materials and features for healthier indoor environments.

C:P1.13.text: Built to fit your life and budget.

C:P1.14.text: When you build a new home with us, you enjoy complete control and only pay for the things that matter most.

C:P1.15.text: Feel good about the company you keep.

C:P1.17.text: The sales staff was helpful and responsive, and our construction superintendent took us through the home in detail and has been available for questions even after buying our home. C:P1.19.text: I didn't know what to expect when buying from KB. The process was smooth, and the staff was communicative. The web portal with all the information was great, and then after closing, all of your documents are there to view.
